title: Working on a card game
author: Significant-Neck-520
selftext:
[https://youtu.be/BRnZVNOuR9U](https://youtu.be/BRnZVNOuR9U)  
So this is the current state of my card game. Got in a situation where I can't see how AI works out for setting up the campaign, a lot of stuff has to be done manually now.   
Being developed in Unity, Code was made from Gemini, and the images... well, they are also from Gemini. Still, a lot of work will be necessary to get into a build I can open to the public.
